name: mykavo
description: Ask about your MyKavo website monitoring: what changed, which site needs attention, scans, site audits and AI crawler visits. Read-only.

interface.shortDescription: Ask what changed or broke on the websites you monitor
interface.longDescription: MyKavo monitors websites for important changes and regressions: SEO tags, availability, visual layout, broken links, third-party scripts, performance and key conversion elements. Connect your MyKavo workspace to ask in plain words which site needs attention, what changed this week, what a specific change was, what the latest site audit found and which AI crawlers read your pages. Every answer comes from your real monitoring data with a link to the before-and-after in MyKavo. Read-only: it never changes settings, approves changes or starts scans. Requires a MyKavo Pro or Agency plan.
defaultPrompt: Is anything wrong with my websites right now?
What changed on my sites this week?
Summarise the latest site audit for my main website
